main_text.p: plures; Ricardus Lyncombe septem meretri-ces habebat, quatuor solutas & tres coniuga-tas, eratq; Sodomita. Guilhelmus Beuushon undecim scorta quoqʒ habebat, praeter Sodo-mitici[?] uariū genus. In Monkenfarlegensi cœ-nobio Sarisburiensis dioecesis, Ludouicus prior nouem habuit meretrices, & conuentus adhuc plures. Ricardus prior de Mayde Brad-ley, quinq; meretrices & sex spurios habuit. Guilhelmus abbas Bristollensis, quatuor me-retrices habuit, tres solutas, & unam coniuga-tam. Thomas abbas Abindonensis, praeter so-rorem naturalem, ex qua duas procreauit so-boles, tres alias meretrices habuit: & hic pa-ter multorum Sodomitarum fuit. In cœno-bio de Shulbrede Cicestriensis dioecesis, Ge-orgius Vualden prior, septem meretrices ha-buit, Ioannes Standney septem, Nicolaus Du-ke quinq; Henricus Seluuode duas, praeter reliquos & reliquas. Ioânes Blanke prior de Bermondsey, uiginti meretrices habuit.

Vt ad sacrificulorum collegia ueniamus: In castro de Vuindesora, Hericus Vuoduuar de succentor, plures meretrices habuit: Nico-laus Vulhyde quatuor, Georgius Vuhitethor-ne quinq, Nicolaus Spoke quinq, Robertus Hune quinq, Simon Todde unam, Nicolaus Vualker, duas, Guilhelmus Vuafe unam, Ro-bertus Dauyson sex, Petrus Bough multas, & alij alias. In ecclesia cathedrali Cicestriæ:

page.notes: Heavy ink strokes (underlining and strikes) run across lines of the top section, over "Ricardus Lyncombe", "Guilhelmus Beuushon", "Abindonensis", "uiginti meretrices habuit" and "Vt ad"; the words beneath them are read as printed. Left edge is damaged, with the first letters of several lines partly lost. Line 4 of the first paragraph ("mifmi uariu genus") is doubtful. "Sarisburiensis" and "Ioânes" are read from a faint scan.
